audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to play around Relentless Pursuit being 'down'. It is 16s at rank 1, but Lightslinger attacks REDUCE its cooldown — so every double-shot he lands gives it back. Timing his dash off a stopwatch is the wrong instruction.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.'
audit.corrected: Deny him attacks, not seconds: if he is hitting you or the wave with Lightslinger double-shots, the dash is already back regardless of what the 16s timer says.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ardent Blaze marks and briefly REVEALS enemies. Against Aurora that is the counter to Across the Veil's invisibility, and it is never mentioned. Also unmentioned: Lightslinger is empowered whenever a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, so your own team's CC feeds his burst.
audit.why: Riot's text: W 'marking and briefly revealing enemies'; P 'when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage'.
audit.corrected: Do not leap into his Ardent Blaze mark expecting to disappear — the mark reveals you. And when your support lands CC, expect his next two attacks to hit harder, not softer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places claim Aurora 'walks through the wall untargetable' so The Culling whiffs. Between Worlds grants no untargetability, and The Culling is a 1400-range channel of shots she cannot simply be immune to.
audit.why: Between Worlds: damage, slow, and a teleport across the zone. Nothing more.
audit.corrected: The rift beats The Culling by slowing him inside it and by letting you cross the zone mid-channel to break his line — not by making you untargetable.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers. The Culling is 110s at rank 1 and Piercing Light is 9s — neither appears.
audit.corrected: The Culling 110s; Ardent Blaze 14s; Piercing Light 9s; Relentless Pursuit 16s but refunded by Lightslinger.
